rationale: Round 2 has clarified the trade-offs and produced more concrete package elements, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and the state still reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still insist those tools remain available if needed. Positions have hardened into a stable but not yet fully exhausted impasse, so another round could still test specific non-closure capacity-reduction options and quantify whether a viable shared-sacrifice package exists.
